observations: A: cadaveric overview with visible C5, C6, C7, C8, T1 labels and vertebral background after removal of anterior scalene.
B: five roots, three trunks, six divisions, three cords and branches are visible and labeled.
C: specimen includes C4–T1 labels plus ST/MT/IT; D: terminal branch numeric labels refer to the original caption.

orientationNote: A画面右侧为脊柱侧、左侧为外周上肢；B按左侧根到右侧末支组织。只是原图布局；未确认患者左右侧，不把图的屏幕方向套入三维坐标或超声探头方向。
